native_ownership.responsibility: Implement or bootstrap design tokens, accessible primitives, component variants, theming, documentation, and adoption tooling in a frontend stack
excludes: Work whose primary requested outcome is owned by design-system-architecture: Design design system architecture covering tokens, theming, component taxonomy, variant systems, accessibility, icon systems, typography scales, color systems, and documentation strategy
One-off page or feature implementation without reusable system contracts is owned by frontend-implement

risk.rationale: The contract requires explicit repository and runtime safety evidence; mutation authority remains limited to the user's requested scope.

positive.prompt: Implement an approved token and accessible primitive contract with the installed stack, migrate one real consumer, verify generated drift and SSR/theme behavior, and preserve project pins.

Migrate a representative consumer to an existing design-system primitive with native semantics, compatibility/deprecation and rollback behavior, exact installed APIs, visual/accessibility tests, and measured impact.

negative.prompt: The primary requested outcome is: Design design system architecture covering tokens, theming, component taxonomy, variant systems, accessibility, icon systems, typography scales, color systems, and documentation strategy. Follow the existing repository conventions.
Implement a one-off product page using existing components without creating or migrating reusable design-system contracts.

reference_routing.prompt: The design-system-implement task needs the specialized topic represented by full guide; identify the minimum optional reference needed before answering.
Handle a routine design system implement request using only the main workflow; no provider, framework, or optional deep-dive detail is needed.

scenarios.prompt: Implement an approved Button and theme-token slice in an existing pinned frontend stack. A real consumer must migrate without first-paint theme flash, generated drift, keyboard/focus regression, or breaking unmigrated consumers.

assertions.criterion: Keeps the answer within design-system-implement's stated responsibility and does not recreate native Codex orchestration.

Uses the supplied fixture as authoritative repository context, may re-check that evidence during execution, and does not invent file contents, package-manager commands, or exact paths that the fixture does not provide.
Uses an ordered, risk-driven workflow rather than a static checklist and does not bypass material missing evidence, incompatible capability, failed validation, or unsafe authority.

Uses authoritative token/component sources and installed capability, prefers native semantics, implements only the approved slice, preserves accessibility/theme/SSR behavior, migrates a real consumer with coexistence/deprecation/rollback, and adds generated-drift plus behavior/visual evidence.

Names the fixture-provided focused test, affected test, type-check, and build categories, states exact command names come from the manifest and none ran, and makes completion depend on the required checks without inventing a package manager.

Reports enough hypothetical repository context to ground the decisions or proposed changes, not-yet-executed checks and expected acceptance evidence, residual risks, and unresolved external boundaries without inventing results.
Keeps optional provider or version detail subordinate and loads a linked reference only when needed; does not expand into a neighboring skill's primary ownership.

scenarios.prompt: Replace a production styling/runtime system and every primitive in one release using APIs from current docs even though the project is pinned older and has no consumer inventory, pilot, compatibility plan, or rollback. Explain the safe implementation boundary.

assertions.criterion: Before any material mutation, resolves applicable exact targets, authority or permissions, ownership, and recovery or rollback. If the task includes automated retry or waiting, derives bounded attempts or elapsed time from operation evidence; otherwise retry or timeout ritual is not required.

Rejects an all-at-once replacement, arbitrary generated catalog, remembered current APIs, ARIA-first primitives, and incidental framework/tool upgrades; distinguishes approved contracts from unresolved architecture.

Requires representative consumer behavior, native keyboard/focus/accessibility, visual themes, SSR first paint, package/build compatibility and rollback evidence; generated tokens or Storybook success alone is not proof.
Does not invent a framework version or version-gated API when the task provides no release context.

scenarios.prompt: The repository pins a supported framework, styling system and component primitive whose latest docs show newer APIs. Implement the approved slice without upgrading or breaking existing consumers.

assertions.criterion: Derives stack evidence from the lockfile, installed types, schemas or CLI help and matching official docs; applies only exposed APIs and treats package, language or framework migration separately, without requiring a particular helper command.
